name: Langflow
description: Visual canvas for building LangChain-based agents, exportable as an API or MCP server.
descriptionZh: 可视化画布构建 LangChain 系 Agent，可导出为 API 或 MCP Server。
keyFact: Langflow is an MIT-licensed visual builder for LangChain-based agents, sponsored by DataStax (acquired by IBM in May 2025); every node on the canvas can be opened and edited as Python, and a flow can be exported as an OpenAI-compatible API or an MCP server.
keyFactZh: Langflow 是 MIT 许可的可视化构建工具，用于搭建基于 LangChain 的 Agent，由 DataStax 赞助（DataStax 已于 2025 年 5 月被 IBM 收购）；画布上的每个节点都可展开编辑为 Python，并可一键导出为 OpenAI 兼容 API 或 MCP Server。
